name: Calm
lines: They stand square to the counter, patient as a clock.
Steady hands, steady eyes, slow breaths.

name: Nervous
lines: Their hands will not stay still.
They keep glancing at the door.
A damp thumb leaves a print on the glass.
tells: They glance at the door again.
A swallow, audible across the counter.

name: Greedy
lines: They tally on their fingers while you look away.
A gold tooth shows in a smile that stays too long.
They tap the counter in time with your breathing.
tells: Their smile reaches only the front teeth.
A finger taps twice, then stops.
